entities.summary: Christopher Frederick Andrews is a British-German singer-songwriter and producer whose musical career started in the late 1950s. His biggest hits as a solo artist include "To Whom It Concerns", "Yesterday Man" and "Pretty Belinda". Between 1965 and 1970, across five countries, thirteen of his songs reached number one.
